decision: The source-only low-rank explicit LUT predictor has repeatable cross-population predictive value and improves both mean and tail error over one global LUT, but all three populations violate the frozen 10% P95 analytical-limiting gate. The fixed grid, rank, regularization, predictor and residual execution close without tuning or confirmation acquisition.
forbidden_rescue: do not tune grid size, basis rank, shrinkage, smoothness, descriptor, ridge alphas, target, AO6 or the 10% gate on these outcomes
do not download a new confirmation population for BJ0
do not run visual review after automatic failure
do not claim film, stock, calibration, preference or product value
allowed_next: test a separately preregistered intrinsically cube-preserving explicit operator representation that changes the mathematical residual basis rather than retuning BJ0
claim_ceiling: negative development decision for one adaptive explicit LUT-basis predictor with positive digital-retouch prediction evidence but excessive safety-limited tail
